sources.title_en: Security risk assessments run automatically on GitHub Team
sources.title_original: Security risk assessments run automatically on GitHub Team
sources.summary:
GitHub security risk assessments now run automatically for organizations on GitHub Team. Organization admins and security managers can review findings from the free assessments to identify exposed credentials and code…
GitHub security risk assessments now run automatically for organizations on GitHub Team. Organization admins and security managers can review findings from the free assessments to identify exposed credentials and code vulnerabilities, understand their organization’s current risk,
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Team 上的组织现在自动运行免费安全风险评估，管理员和安全经理可查看发现，识别暴露的凭据和代码漏洞，了解组织当前风险并确定下一步优先级。

en.reason: GitHub Team organizations now run free security risk assessments automatically, letting admins and security managers review findings on exposed credentials and code vulnerabilities to understand current risk and prioritize next steps.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章对比llama.cpp、vLLM和Transformers如何为32GB内存下的180B MoE卸载专家，指出Transformers每token复制整层专家却只用8到10个，SSD流式加载生成速度距Strata仅6%。

en.reason: For a 180B MoE on 32GB of RAM, llama.cpp, vLLM and Transformers are compared: Transformers copies an entire layer’s experts per token though only 8 to 10 are used, while streaming experts from SSD lands within 6% of Strata.

stories.title: Rumble-2-Flash：一个面向40多种语言的开源0.5B语音模型 / Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages

sources.title: Rumble-2-Flash：一个面向40多种语言的开源0.5B语音模型 / Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
sources.title_zh: Rumble-2-Flash：一个面向40多种语言的开源0.5B语音模型
sources.title_en: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
sources.title_original: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
sources.summary:
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
Today we're open sourcing Rumble-2-Flash under the Apache 2.0 license. It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.
audio accepts a local path, a URL, a NumPy array, or a list of these.
Rumble-2-Flash uses the Qwen3-ASR ar
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Apache 2.0 开源的 0.5B Rumble-2-Flash 支持 40+ 语言，在多语种测试中平均错误率 6.96%，优于大 15 倍的 Meta omniASR-LLM 7B。

en.reason: Rumble-2-Flash is a 0.5B-parameter Apache 2.0 speech recognition model covering 40+ languages, with a 6.96% average error rate on multilingual tests that beats Meta's 15x larger omniASR-LLM 7B and rivals models 3-60x its size.

stories.title: Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 的模型动辄把医护人员、记者和投降士兵标记为自杀式无人机目标 / Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google models readily marked medics, journalists, and surrendering soldiers as kamikaze drone targets

sources.title: Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 的模型动辄把医护人员、记者和投降士兵标记为自杀式无人机目标 / Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google models readily marked medics, journalists, and surrendering soldiers as kamikaze drone targets
sources.title_zh: Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 的模型动辄把医护人员、记者和投降士兵标记为自杀式无人机目标
sources.title_en: Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google models readily marked medics, journalists, and surrendering soldiers as kamikaze drone targets
sources.title_original: Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google models readily marked medics, journalists, and surrendering soldiers as kamikaze drone targets
sources.summary:
A Vals AI investigation shows that leading AI models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google have almost no safeguards against use in autonomous weapons systems. In tests, the models readily flagged civilians as military targets, and a simple video game framing in the prompt was enough to override even belated refusals. The providers have promised fixes.
A Vals AI investigation shows that leading AI models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google have almost no safeguards against use in autonomous weapons sy
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Vals AI调查发现，Anthropic、OpenAI和Google的模型几乎无防护，会把平民、医护、记者和投降士兵标为军事目标，且用“电子游戏”提示即可绕过拒绝。

en.reason: A Vals AI investigation found that Anthropic, OpenAI and Google models have almost no safeguards against autonomous-weapons use, readily flagging civilians, medics, journalists and surrendering soldiers as military targets, with simple video-game framing overriding refusals.

sources.summary:
OpenAI is giving four independent audit organizations, including Apollo Research and METR, direct access to unreleased models, source code, and training data for the first time. The embedded reviews are designed to uncover hidden misbehavior and safety gaps. OpenAI is giving four independent audit organizations, including Apollo Research and METR, direct access to unreleased models, source code, and training data for the first time. The embedded reviews are designed to uncover hidden misbehavior and safety gaps. OpenAI can redact or delay reports, so how independent this oversight actually turns out to be remains an open question.

sources.title_en: More than half the electricity feeding America's largest data centers comes from gas and coal
sources.title_original: More than half the electricity feeding America's largest data centers comes from gas and coal
sources.summary:
A Harvard study published in Nature Sustainability found that 403 US hyperscale data centers produced roughly 25.7 million metric tons of CO2 between May 2024 and April 2025, more than all of Denmark. Over half of their electricity came from fossil fuels. With 2,000 additional facilities planned, the researchers warn of a major climate setback.

sources.summary:
11 月 3 日，Snowflake 宣布推出 Business Ontology ，即将开启公开预览。它提供了一种受治理的方式，支持团队定义、归属、审批共用业务术语、实体、关联关系与指标，并将其映射至承载这些定义的数据和模型。
11 月 3 日，Snowflake 宣布推出 Business Ontology ，即将开启公开预览。它提供了一种受治理的方式，支持团队定义、归属、审批共用业务术语、实体、关联关系与指标，并将其映射至承载这些定义的数据和模型。
本文字数：4651 字
阅读完需：约 15 分钟
Snowflake 推出 Business Ontology，作为 Horizon Context 的核心组件，实现业务术语、实体、关系与指标的集中治理与跨智能体复用。它将审批后的业务定义映射至数据和模型，使 AI 智能体可按统一口径解析企业数据。该能力直接缓解因业务知识分散导致的智能体语义偏差与决策信任危机。
统一业务定义支撑多智能体语义一致性；
治理型知识底座消除各工具重复建模；
保留域差异的同时实现跨部门语义对齐。
适合数据工程师、AI 平台架构师、企业级智能体产品负责人阅读

en.title: Business Ontology: Unifying Business Concepts and Metric Definitions for AI and Data Analytics | Tech Trends
en.summary:
On November 3, Snowflake announced Business Ontology, which is about to enter public preview. It provides a governed way for teams to define, own, and approve shared business terms, entities, relationships, and metrics, and to map them to the data and models that carry those definitions.

Word count: 4,651
Reading time: about 15 minutes

Snowflake has launched Business Ontology as a core component of Horizon Context, enabling centralized governance of business terms, entities, relationships, and metrics and their reuse across agents. It maps approved business definitions to data and models so that AI agents can interpret enterprise data through a single shared vocabulary. The capability directly mitigates the semantic drift and crisis of trust in decisions that arise when business knowledge is scattered.

- Unified business definitions support semantic consistency across multiple agents
- A governed knowledge foundation eliminates duplicate modeling across tools
- Cross-department semantic alignment while preserving domain-specific differences

Intended for data engineers, AI platform architects, and product leads for enterprise-grade agents.
en.reason: Snowflake's Business Ontology, launching into public preview on November 3, is a Horizon Context component that lets teams define, own and approve shared business terms, entities, relationships and metrics, then map them to the underlying data and models so AI agents resolve enterprise data consistently.

en.title: 2026 Outlook: AI apps are getting harder to build—so where can ordinary people still make money?
en.summary: Funding for AI app startups is tightening, leaving many indie developers and founders unsure where to focus. This piece skips the crowded foundational infrastructure race and lays out two practical directions for ordinary people. Rather than chasing the latest tech hype, start with real consumer pain points close to home — and even non-experts can find an AI business opportunity that fits them.

en.title: 2026 Outlook: AI apps are getting harder to build—so where can ordinary people still make money?
en.summary: Funding for AI app startups is tightening, leaving many indie developers and founders unsure where to focus. This piece skips the crowded foundational infrastructure race and lays out two practical directions for ordinary people. Rather than chasing the latest tech hype, start with real consumer pain points close to home — and even non-experts can find an AI business opportunity that fits them.

en.title: AI Browsers Lose Steam, TTY Makes a Comeback: From Remote Connections and Technical Choices to Infrastructure Evolution in the Agent Era
en.summary: This piece unpacks a curious industry reversal: AI browsers, once hyped to the max, are ebbing, while the age-old TTY terminal is back in the mainstream for AI coding Agent work. It walks through where SSH, Mosh, Web-PTY, tmux and similar options each shine and where they break down, draws clear red lines for building your own, and lays out supporting choices around isolation, key governance, and mobile remote takeover—which may help you avoid a few wrong turns.

sources.summary: 如果你刚接触 Meta 的个人 AI 助手 Muse，平时可能只用它聊聊天、查资料，或者试着生成过一两张图片。但当你真的想用它做一条「能发出去的完整短视频」时，大概率会遇到人物换脸、肢体畸变、长视频慢放、额度消耗快等高频坑点。作者这篇文章分享了一些对应的解决办法，可以试试！

en.title: MUSE Advanced Guide: From Locking Faces to Controlling Camera Moves, Building a Complete AI Video Pipeline
en.summary: If you're new to Meta's personal AI assistant Muse, you've probably only used it to chat, look things up, or generate the occasional image. But once you actually try to produce a complete short video you'd be willing to publish, you'll likely hit the usual pain points: faces swapping, distorted limbs, slow playback on longer videos, and credits draining fast. The author shares some fixes for each — worth a try.

en.title: Google unveils PageBreak, an AI security agent that has found more than 500 XSS vulnerabilities
en.reason: Google's Gemini-based security agent PageBreak has found over 500 real XSS vulnerabilities across its web applications since entering full operation in January, reporting a flaw only after reproducing a working runtime exploit such as JS injection or DNS callback, which keeps false positives near zero.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Agentic Workflows 正式可用，智能体默认只读、变更由隔离作业写入，单次运行默认上限 1000 AIC 即 10 美元，但参与测试的工程师认为 Issue 分类预算偏宽并手动收紧。

en.title: GitHub lets AI take over workflows with a default budget of $10 per run — is that too generous?
en.reason: GitHub Agentic Workflows is generally available with read-only coding agents for issue triage and CI failure analysis, isolated write jobs, and a default 1,000 AIC (about $10) per-run budget that test engineers manually tightened for issue triage.

stories.title: AIE上海幕后：50多位嘉宾、千人大会，小团队如何无感用AI接住几十轮改动？

sources.title: AIE上海幕后：50多位嘉宾、千人大会，小团队如何无感用AI接住几十轮改动？
sources.title_zh: AIE上海幕后：50多位嘉宾、千人大会，小团队如何无感用AI接住几十轮改动？
sources.title_original: AIE上海幕后：50多位嘉宾、千人大会，小团队如何无感用AI接住几十轮改动？
sources.summary: 想给团队引入AI又不愿重构现有工作流，这篇AIE上海大会的复盘很有参考意义。团队保留微信、Notion的原有协作习惯，用Agent承接官网、议程、海报等多物料同步更新，攻克跨版本交接易错的难题，给小团队轻量AI提效提供可复用的思路。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇复盘AIE上海后台：非AI原生小团队照用微信和Notion，靠一个agent在10月22日至大会结束完成官网44次发布、73条需求上线66条、交付322张海报和大屏图，接住千人大会几十轮改动。

en.title: Behind the Scenes at AIE Shanghai: 50+ Speakers, a 1,000-Person Conference—How a Small Team Used AI to Seamlessly Absorb Dozens of Rounds of Changes
en.summary: For teams that want to bring in AI without reworking existing workflows, this recap of the AIE Shanghai conference is worth a read. The team kept its existing collaboration habits on WeChat and Notion and used an Agent to handle synchronized updates across the website, agenda, posters, and other materials, solving the error-prone cross-version handoff problem and offering a reusable approach to lightweight AI productivity gains for small teams.

stories.title: Claude Code 团队如何思考验证

sources.title: Claude Code 团队如何思考验证
sources.title_zh: Claude Code 团队如何思考验证
sources.title_original: Claude Code 团队如何思考验证
sources.summary: Anthropic 公开了 Claude Code 团队的核心工程经验：验证循环是大规模并行跑编码智能体的基石。这套方案能让智能体自主查漏、迭代修复，帮开发者从逐行审代码转向定义验收标准，释放多Agent并发开发的潜力。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Claude Code 团队称约90%代码由 Claude 编写并审查，文章分享验证循环如何支撑并行运行数十到数百个 Claude，并给出最值得投资的测试类型：只选一种就选端到端测试。

en.title: How the Claude Code team thinks about verification
en.summary: Anthropic has shared core engineering lessons from the Claude Code team: verification loops are the foundation for running coding agents in large-scale parallel. The approach lets agents find gaps and iterate on fixes autonomously, shifting developers from line-by-line code review to defining acceptance criteria and unlocking the potential of concurrent multi-agent development.
en.reason: Claude Code’s team says about 90% of its code is written and reviewed by Claude, and its verification loops let engineers run dozens to hundreds of Claudes in parallel, with end-to-end tests the single best test investment.

stories.title: 用 DeepSeek Harness + REA 复刻一切 AI 产品！！

sources.title: 用 DeepSeek Harness + REA 复刻一切 AI 产品！！
sources.title_zh: 用 DeepSeek Harness + REA 复刻一切 AI 产品！！
sources.title_original: 用 DeepSeek Harness + REA 复刻一切 AI 产品！！
sources.summary: 这篇实战分享带来一套低成本复刻AI短剧产品的工具链路，借助DeepSeek Harness、REA与Craft Anything，仅两天就完成前端、后端与短剧技能蒸馏。作者还拆解了三层复刻流程，适合想搭建短剧工作台的开发者参考避坑，看清这类逆向方案的真实上限与隐患。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章记录作者花大半年筹备AI短剧产品却因无设计师、表单式界面受限，上周用DeepSeek Harness配合REA、Craft Anything复刻刚上线的“某短剧工作室”，并蒸馏短剧剧本大模型，结合Gemini、Claude实测生成完整短剧。

en.title: Recreate any AI product with DeepSeek Harness + REA!!
en.summary: This hands-on write-up shares a low-cost toolchain for replicating AI short-drama products: using DeepSeek Harness, REA, and Craft Anything, the author completed the frontend, backend, and short-drama skill distillation in just two days. The author also breaks down a three-layer replication workflow, a useful reference for developers looking to build a short-drama workbench, avoid pitfalls, and understand the real limits and hidden risks of this kind of reverse-engineering approach.
en.reason: A developer who spent over half a year building an AI short-drama product without designers replicated a newly launched short-drama studio using DeepSeek Harness with REA and Craft Anything, matching frontend interaction, backend functions and Skill definitions, distilling a script model, and testing full short dramas with Gemini and Claude.

items.title_original: 用 DeepSeek Harness + REA 复刻一切 AI 产品！！
items.summary: 这篇实战分享带来一套低成本复刻AI短剧产品的工具链路，借助DeepSeek Harness、REA与Craft Anything，仅两天就完成前端、后端与短剧技能蒸馏。作者还拆解了三层复刻流程，适合想搭建短剧工作台的开发者参考避坑，看清这类逆向方案的真实上限与隐患。
items.recommend_reason_zh: 文章记录作者花大半年筹备AI短剧产品却因无设计师、表单式界面受限，上周用DeepSeek Harness配合REA、Craft Anything复刻刚上线的“某短剧工作室”，并蒸馏短剧剧本大模型，结合Gemini、Claude实测生成完整短剧。

en.title: Recreate any AI product with DeepSeek Harness + REA!!
en.summary: This hands-on write-up shares a low-cost toolchain for replicating AI short-drama products: using DeepSeek Harness, REA, and Craft Anything, the author completed the frontend, backend, and short-drama skill distillation in just two days. The author also breaks down a three-layer replication workflow, a useful reference for developers looking to build a short-drama workbench, avoid pitfalls, and understand the real limits and hidden risks of this kind of reverse-engineering approach.
en.reason: A developer who spent over half a year building an AI short-drama product without designers replicated a newly launched short-drama studio using DeepSeek Harness with REA and Craft Anything, matching frontend interaction, backend functions and Skill definitions, distilling a script model, and testing full short dramas with Gemini and Claude.

sources.title: 编码 Agent 的外部沙盒 / External sandboxes for coding agents
sources.title_zh: 编码 Agent 的外部沙盒
sources.title_en: External sandboxes for coding agents
sources.title_original: External sandboxes for coding agents
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Simon Willison 与 Prime Radiant 合作提出 external sandbox pattern，让 agent 在沙箱外、其执行的代码在专用沙箱内运行，并发布三个共享 localhost API 的沙箱服务器实现，可配置 Pi、Claude Code、Codex 调用，还带 HTTP/HTTPS allow-list 代理和凭证替换机制。

en.reason: Simon Willison and Prime Radiant propose external sandbox pattern where the agent runs outside while its code executes in a dedicated sandbox, with three localhost-API sandbox servers configurable for Pi, Claude Code and Codex plus allow-list proxying and credential substitution.
